failed_test.cause: Web 20331871 ("fix: reload web caches after a full server restore (#630)", from main) adds server_restore_id to every Cloud API request. Server 805c9bab0 has no such parameter and SpaceCreatorPageQuery (libs/appflowy-entity/src/database/dto.rs) has #[serde(deny_unknown_fields)], so GET /api/workspace/{id}/space-creators?server_restore_id=...&kind=user&limit=200 answers 400 "Query deserialize error: unknown field `server_restore_id`, expected one of `kind`, `after`, `limit`". The panel shows "We couldn't load the selected members and groups." with Retry.

browser.recorder: Playwright recordVideo, one VP8 webm per window at 25 fps (Playwright ffmpeg-1011); no audio
browser.session: GoTrue password grant stored as the app session, except Jordan, who signs in on the login screen
browser.network: Runs C and D: the app's HTTP requests outside the three stack origins aborted; WebSockets and Chromium's own background traffic not filtered (the realtime relay connected any URL). Runs E and F: also Chromium started with --proxy-server=http://127.0.0.1:9 (closed; Chromium never proxies loopback), the app's WebSockets outside the stack closed before they connect, and the relay limited to the Cloud socket; sampling the sockets of the Playwright process tree every 0.2 s found only loopback peers (see runs).

videos.overlays: Drawn by the recording harness, not the app: a caption banner at the top (the step in plain words, text in CSS generated content) and a dot marking the pointer, both aria-hidden with pointer-events none. Browser spell-check underlines turned off, as for the screenshots.
videos.composition: At each moment the most recently opened window that is still open is shown; each part starts at the next caption in its window and the clip ends when the last window closed. findings.finding: edit-group-edits had no try/finally; a failure after Sam typed left his sentence on the page

findings.verified: scratch run with a failure injected after the server had the sentence: original error reported, cleanup check passed, page back to its seeded line; restorePageText alone on a half-typed line with a nested child gave back the seeded document JSON exactly

findings.finding: "Every change a test makes is undone" did not hold for the edit history
findings.fix: README, spec header and this manifest say settings and page text are put back, edit history is not

findings.finding: the network guard covered only the app HTTP requests (Chromium background traffic reached Google; WebSockets not filtered)
findings.fix: Chromium --proxy-server=http://127.0.0.1:9; WebSockets outside the stack closed; relay limited to the Cloud socket; both WebSocket rules are URL patterns
findings.verified: blank-page probe of the same Chromium, 30 s: five Google addresses (443, 5228) without the flag, no socket with it (example.com failed, the stack Cloud connected); scratch loopback server on a port outside the stack: request and upgrade from a plain context, nothing from guarded or relayed ones; socket sampling in runs G2, E and F: loopback peers only
